preconditions: strictly ordered complete terrain profile covering the support

equations.terrain: piecewise linear interpolation between adjacent DEM profile samples
equations.intersection: solve z_c(s)-z_t(s)=0 independently inside each terrain segment

decisionLogic: Split at every exact affine intersection and retain only portions with contact elevation at or below terrain. Classify uncertainty samples as definitely below, possibly below or definitely above.
outputs: zero or more nominal subsurface polylines
uncertainty: A numerical elevation tolerance snaps machine-scale residuals at terrain nodes; it is not geological uncertainty.
validationMethod: analytic planar crossing, relief case, incomplete terrain rejection and full regression
reopenCondition: Curved contacts, DEM uncertainty propagation, discontinuities/faults or authorized multi-contact assembly are introduced.
